blocks.text: Fashioned in stylish natural/light grey cushions, this wonderful outdoor chair set adds a soft touch of elegance to any patio or garden. Its structure incorporates acacia wood, known for its solidity and durability. The set comes with foam-filled cushions wrapped in weather-resistant fabric, providing a cozy outdoor lounging experience. Enjoy the blend of style, comfort and virtue with the Dune Lounge Chair Set. A wonderful addition to make your outdoor space even more inviting and relaxing.

items.label: [SET OF 2 OUTDOOR LOUNGE CHAIRS]
items.value: Designed for relaxed outdoor seating on patios, decks, porches, or gardens; modern lounge silhouette offers comfort for everyday outdoor living

items.label: [DURABLE ACACIA WOOD FRAME]
items.value: Crafted from solid acacia wood with an oil-based finish for lasting outdoor durability, stability, and natural resistance to wear

items.label: [COMFORTABLE CUSHIONED SEATING]
items.value: Foam-filled cushions wrapped in weather-resistant polyester fabric provide supportive comfort for lounging and entertaining

items.label: [SPACIOUS LOUNGE DIMENSIONS]
items.value: Each chair measures 32.7" W x 34.4" D x 24.4" H with a seat size of 32.7" W x 25.6" D x 10.8" H; supports up to 225 lbs per chair; assembly required

items.label: [TRUSTED BRAND]
items.value: SAFAVIEH has been a trusted brand and leader in home furnishings for over 100 years, using their specialty and expertise in crafting the trendiest and highest quality designs and selection of colors; Begin your outdoor furniture search with SAFAVIEH and explore over 100,000 products today
